All evidence carried after a changed critical premise.

positive_controls.argument: A reproducible mainline build and visible integration failures provide a current executable reference for maintained engineering knowledge.
The verified mainline gives configuration accounting an actual integrated candidate and a meaningful health state rather than unrelated branch badges.
Early integration and explicit failures provide impact evidence before more dependent work accumulates on incompatible assumptions.
Frequent real combination exercises compatibility and exposes semantic disagreement while the responsible changes are still localizable.
A reproducible integrated candidate enables early execution of proposed acceptance methods and exposes missing fixtures or impossible criteria.
Identified mainline commits, build inputs and integration outcomes supply concrete endpoints for trace relations across interacting work.
Actual integration outcomes provide current evidence or defeaters for the compatibility subclaim and reveal when a previously cited candidate has changed.
A promptly identified failing integration and its responsible changes provide a bounded anomaly witness and a repair-validation opportunity.
A reproducible mainline and its actual combined behavior supply a current executable realization to compare with model or schema claims.
The actually combined mainline supplies the shared candidate and credible integration result that separate branch automation lacks.
